title: Forbidden Shadows

moves: Slide left, revolving door (Partner Star Prom 1/2, robins allemande right 1/2)
(Larks Ricochet, Neigh R, Robins L, Part R, Lark L, Neigh R, Robins L)
Pass partner right, Shadow 2 Left shoulder 1

notes: Rochelle Hodge told me once that when your shadow becomes your neighbor, swinging them feels forbidden. This inspired the choreography in the B.
Teaching note -- Before you begin, look passed your partner to see shadow 1. Turn away from your partner to see shadow 2.
